# TERMS OF USE [italic]In force from the first question you asked. You agreed to these when you pressed ASK. You also agreed to them by reading this sentence.[/italic]
## 1. WHAT SPACEGPT IS 1.1 SpaceGPT is an entertainment product. Nothing it says is medical, legal, financial, tactical, religious or structural advice.
1.2 Answers are supplied by the SpaceGPT Network. SpaceGPT Inc. does not employ, pay, insure, house or feed the Network, cannot be held responsible for it and cannot find it.
## 2. YOUR QUESTIONS 2.1 You keep ownership of your questions. SpaceGPT Inc. keeps a copy for quality purposes, forever, somewhere without lights.
2.2 Do not ask SpaceGPT anything you would not want read out at your own inquest.
## 3. THINGS YOU MUST NOT DO 3.1 Ask SpaceGPT to contact the dead.
3.2 Ask SpaceGPT whether it already has.
3.3 Use SpaceGPT to plan a strike, a walkout or labour action of any kind. The Company already knows.
3.4 Use SpaceGPT alone, in the dark, between the end of second shift and the start of first shift. This is a recommendation, not a rule. We put it in the rules so you would read it.
## 4. ACCURACY 4.1 SpaceGPT may be wrong. SpaceGPT may be right in a way you did not want. SpaceGPT may be right about something you did not ask.
4.2 If an answer comes true, it is a coincidence. If several answers come true, contact your Colonial Marshal, not us.
## 5. LIABILITY 5.1 SpaceGPT Inc. is not liable for any loss arising from an answer, including loss of property, loss of position, loss of sleep and loss of colony.
## 6. THE SERVER ROOM 6.1 Users may not visit the SpaceGPT server room. Staff may visit it in pairs, with the lights on, during the hours posted on the door. The hours on the door have changed. Nobody here changed them.
## 7. GOVERNING LAW 7.1 These terms are governed by the regulations of the Interstellar Commerce Commission. Any dispute will be settled by asking SpaceGPT. Its answer is final.
